title: ci: run test-mysql57-s3-nfs against a local S3Mock instead of the remote bucket
darkBefore: cnpmcore's test-mysql57-s3-nfs CI job was dark on master: the remote S3 bucket it used answered every request with HTTP 530, so the job stayed dark run after run.
note: Lit upstream: the job now runs against a local S3Mock service container instead of the remote bucket. The first master run after the merge (Node.js CI 38202391845) has all three test-mysql57-s3-nfs jobs lit.
